_provenance.source_pdf: Nicolas Slonimsky - Thesaurus OfScales And Melodic Patterns.pdf

engine_rules.name: Equal division of octave by tritone yields 2-part progression
engine_rules.falsifier: Slice has no harmonic tension permitting tritone-symmetric melodic motion
engine_rules.anchor: The Tritone divides one octave into two equal parts.

engine_rules.name: Equal division of octave into 3 parts = augmented triad / Coltrane Giant Steps cycle
engine_rules.falsifier: Underlying harmony explicitly forbids augmented-triad principal tones (e.g. naturally-tuned diatonic ii-V-I with no symmetry context)
engine_rules.anchor: The Ditone Progression is identical with the augmented triad. ... [via Coltrane's Giant Steps]

engine_rules.name: Equal division of octave into 4 parts = diminished-7 chord
engine_rules.falsifier: Diatonic context where diminished symmetry would obscure rather than illuminate the underlying chord function
engine_rules.anchor: The Sesquitone Progression is identical with the diminished-seventh chord.

engine_rules.name: Equal division of octave into 6 parts = whole-tone scale
engine_rules.falsifier: Strict diatonic context where whole-tone color would clash unambiguously
engine_rules.anchor: The Whole-Tone scale divides the octave into 6 equal parts.

engine_rules.name: Interpolation preserves direction; result is still a Scale
engine_rules.falsifier: The interpolated note creates an audible direction reversal mid-progression

engine_rules.name: Infrapolation reverses direction; result is a Pattern
engine_rules.falsifier: The infrapolated note does not produce a direction reversal (e.g. notation error)

engine_rules.name: Ultrapolation reverses direction; result is a Pattern
engine_rules.falsifier: The ultrapolated note does not produce a direction reversal
engine_rules.anchor: All ultrapolated progressions are Patterns. Pattern No. 53 inserts G above F#.

engine_rules.name: Symmetric interpolation produces palindromic interval structure
engine_rules.falsifier: Author intends an asymmetric interpolation; symmetric guarantee inappropriate
engine_rules.anchor: Symmetric interpolation results in invertible progressions. Scale No. 37 (C, D, F, F#, G, Bb, C).

engine_rules.name: Infra-inter-ultrapolation: maximally compound decoration of a single figure
engine_rules.falsifier: Decoration density exceeds slice's rhythmic carrying capacity
engine_rules.anchor: Pattern formed by insertion of notes below, between, and above the principal tones. Pattern No. 341.

engine_rules.name: Coltrane Giant Steps cycle: deploy ditone-progression as cadential ladder
engine_rules.falsifier: Player is working in a tradition (bebop, swing, fusion) that doesn't deploy Coltrane-cycle vocabulary
engine_rules.anchor: Equal Division of Octave into Three Parts (Ditone Progression) is the Giant Steps cycle.

engine_rules.name: Pat Martino-style: pivot lines through equal-division axes
engine_rules.falsifier: Player explicitly working in a non-Martino tradition
engine_rules.anchor: [Martino's] linear concept uses Slonimsky-style equal-division pivots extensively; diminished and augmented symmetric divisions central to his vocabulary.

engine_rules.name: McLaughlin-style: symmetric-diminished scale on altered dominants
engine_rules.falsifier: Style is traditional-bebop where diminished color would feel anachronistic
engine_rules.anchor: Symmetric-diminished scales and polation patterns visible across [McLaughlin's] Mahavishnu Orchestra and acoustic output.

engine_rules.name: Master Chord: dom7 with 5th omitted, transposable a tritone
engine_rules.falsifier: Bass line requires the 5th to clarify root function
engine_rules.anchor: Master chords ... dominant-seventh chords with the fifth omitted ... transposable a tritone with satisfactory results.

engine_rules.name: Four mutually exclusive triads exhaust the chromatic aggregate
engine_rules.falsifier: Strict modal or tonal context that resists polytonal coverage
engine_rules.anchor: Four triads (major, minor, diminished, or augmented) comprising all 12 different tones. Example: C major, F# major, D minor, G# minor.

engine_rules.name: Pandiatonic counterpoint: each voice uses all 7 diatonic tones with no vertical doubling
engine_rules.falsifier: Voicing has fewer voices than would distribute the 7 diatonic tones meaningfully
engine_rules.anchor: In strict Pandiatonic Counterpoint each voice uses all 7 different diatonic notes with no vertical duplication.

engine_rules.name: Direction-reversal test discriminates Scale from Pattern
engine_rules.falsifier: Direction reversal happens at terminal point only (still a Scale)
engine_rules.anchor: A scale changes direction only at terminal points. A pattern changes direction before arriving at the terminal point.

engine_rules.name: Prometheus scale (C-D-E-F#-A-Bb): 6-tone alternative to whole-tone for tension color
engine_rules.falsifier: Style is bebop or earlier; Prometheus color reads as anachronistic
engine_rules.anchor: The Prometheus scale: 6-tone scale C, D, E, F#, A, Bb used by Scriabin in his symphonic poem Prometheus.

engine_rules.name: 12-tone technique = permutation case of the semitone progression
engine_rules.falsifier: Style is tonal; chromatic-aggregate exhaustion is the wrong idiom
engine_rules.anchor: 12-Tone Technique, treated here as a special case of permutations of the Semitone Progression.
